_about: RCRotations tuning for MoP Classic: fixes applied on top of every WoWSims rotation (bundled and imported). Syntax: rotations/tuning/README.md. Keys: "*" = every spec, "class/spec", or "class/spec/rotation".

require.why: Dark Transformation needs 5 Shadow Infusion stacks on the ghoul

add.why: WoWSims starts every fight with a seal already on, so it never asks for one. Remind me when I have no seal: Seal of Truth for 1-3 targets
No seal and 4+ targets: Seal of Righteousness
